subject: gk
question: In October 2020, World Bank expected India's GDP to contract by how much percent in the fiscal year 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is **9.6**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• GDP - **Gross Domestic Product **refers to sum total value of all final goods and services, produced in an accounting year, and measured at constant prices of a base year.
 
• There are **3** different methods to calculate GDP- 
 
 
• **Value Added Method**
 
• **Income Method**
 
• **Expenditure Method**
 
 
 
• GDP is an indicator of the economic outlook and growth prospects of a country. 
 
• In India, GDP is measured by **Central Statistical Office, **under the **Ministry of Statistics and Program Implementation.**
 
• GVA - Gross Value Added refers to the value of the number of goods and services produced in an economy minus value of inputs consumed in process of production. 
 
• GVA = Value of Output - Intermediate Consumption

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• World Bank is an International Financial Institution, which provides loans and grants to the governments of low and middle-income countries. 
 
• Established - **1945**
 
• Headquarters - **Washington DC, US**
 
• President - **David Malpass.**
